item.title: Step1 to Autonomy
item.description:
Whats in here

The step 1 is to understand the platform you are working with; this article is for those who are trying to convert a normal vehicle to an autonomous vehicle for research/testing purposes. I would be sharing ideas on how I approached the problem and alternatives with good references I found along the way.

This work is majorly on translating hardware systems to seamlessly interface with software, specifically in context of electric cars. Starting with a basic understanding of the electric vehicle powertrain to implementing a software backbone enabling the vehicle to track a reference trajectory, with a provision for safety override by the user.
